## Answers

### What is Kontablo?
Kontablo is an Esperanto for accounting: a graph-based ontology mapping the 195 sovereign jurisdictions to IFRS/XBRL and to the agentic economy (MCP, A2A, AP2) — one immutable UUID per universal accounting concept, deterministic three-tier resolution.

Source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20738795

### What is Drahma and what did it prove?
Drahma is 36 Socratic virtual tutors for the Ecuadorian curriculum, field-tested with Amazonian communities in August 2024 — built without external funding, model-agnostic via Poe, with guardrails for minors.

Source: https://github.com/DRAHMAN-ORG/drahman-org

### What does Christian Luciani work on?
Complex systems, synthetic cognition for human learning and sovereign open-source infrastructure — from a field-tested educational AI (Drahma) to a universal accounting ontology (Kontablo).

Source: https://christianluciani.github.io

### Does Christian Luciani take consulting work?
Yes — strategic systems consulting with a sovereign-first approach: BI platforms, ERP (Zoho, ERPNext), cash-audit systems and SaaS architecture, where the client keeps the code and the data.

Source: https://christianluciani.github.io
